scoring_justification: Recompute average relative error (MAPE) from the agent's predictions.csv against experimental Tm values contained in the same file; compare against paper-reported thresholds with monotonic tolerance-based scoring. No external hidden labels are needed.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold thresholds for average relative error on training and validation sets.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 4 and main text: training average relative error 2.38%, validation 2.89%.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values transcribed from the paper; verified consistent with the exact predictions provided in the reference solve.sh (which reproduce the paper's reported Tm values).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly from the paper's headline result.

outputs.description: CSV containing the cocrystal name, experimental melting temperature, predicted melting temperature, and split designation (training/validation) for all 61 cocrystals.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the average relative error for training and validation sets from this file and compares each to a hidden gold threshold (paper-reported values + tolerance) using a threshold_or_better policy. The validation split must list exactly the six specified cocrystals.

steps.description: Verify that the validation split includes exactly the six specified cocrystals and no others, and that the remaining 55 are training.
Recompute average relative error (MAPE) on the training set and score against paper target 2.38% with tolerance.
Recompute average relative error (MAPE) on the validation set and score against paper target 2.89% with tolerance.
